div.div:
Replay defense = two layers
timestamp — bounds the window (±5 min)
nonce — makes each signature single-use
timestamp alone: 5-minute replay window
nonce alone: old captures die anyway — but
together they close replay completely

div.div:
Where it earns its complexity
• webhooks — verify sender before trusting payload
• payments / deploy hooks — per-request integrity
• AWS SigV4 — the canonicalization reference
• server-to-server when bearer token isn't enough
not for: public clients (secret ships in binary),
non-repudiation (both sides hold the key)
